outcome: success rate of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
finding: This study found that epidural analgesia during TOLAC in multiparas was associated with a higher success rate of VBAC and did not increase the risk of postpartum bleeding, uterine rupture, or adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: This study found that epidural analgesia during trial of labor after cesarean section (TOLAC) was associated with a higher success rate of vaginal birth and did not increase the risk of postpartum bleeding or uterine rupture.
